sentences.3: He may as well concern himself with the shadow on the wall.

sentences.9: I suppose no man can violate his nature.
sentences.10: All the sallies of his will are rounded in by the law of his being, as the inequalities of Andes and Himmaleh are insignificant in the curve of the sphere.
